oracle.description: templates/dispatch/tests/test_dispatch_release_pr.py decides correctness, together with the two REQ fixtures it supersedes in the shipped L-1 oracle. Written from the spec row by an author with no access to any implementation; the single starts_red command runs the whole driver oracle set.

purpose: Make the L-1 driver's PR step actually open a PR, in templates/dispatch/scripts/dispatch_release.py. gh pr create runs with cwd set to the packet's disposable worktree, and prepare_workspace deliberately removes origin there, so gh has always exited 1 with 'no git remotes found'. Three dispatches reached disposition candidate with every gate green and were finished by hand. prepare_workspace stays as it is -- the worker must have no push route -- and the remote comes back in the driver, after the worker is done, in the PR step only. Add a module constant PR_STEP_NAMES = ("remote-add", "push", "pr-create") and an optional keyword-only drive() parameter push_remote: str | None = None. When push_remote is None, resolve the URL from the coordinator repository's origin with a READ-ONLY git query; the driver must never run a mutating git command outside the packet's worktree. If no URL can be resolved, skip the PR with a recorded reason mentioning the remote and still exit 0 -- a driver that cannot find a remote must not turn a green packet into a failed one. When the disposition is candidate and this is not a dry run, do exactly three things in order, all with cwd set to the worktree: add a remote named origin pointing at the resolved URL; push the packet's own branch (packet["worktree"]["branch"]) with an explicit refspec, never the base branch and never a bare push; then run the existing gh pr create --head. Record the push under report["pr"]["push"] with at least remote and branch. A failure of any of the three sets report["pr"]["failed_step"] to its PR_STEP_NAMES entry, writes exactly one workflow.escalation whose metadata step is "pr", exits non-zero, and never reaches a later part. A dry run adds no remote, pushes nothing and opens nothing, while still reporting the gh pr create it would have run. A non-candidate disposition and every L-2 stop condition must reach neither the push nor gh. Change nothing else in the file: STEPS, RETRY_STEPS, the L-4 retry, the L-2 stop conditions and the never-merge property all stay exactly as they are.
required_outcomes: the PR step adds origin, pushes the packet branch, then runs gh pr create --head, in that order, all in the worktree
the pushed refspec names the packet branch and never the base branch
report['pr'] records the remote and the branch pushed, and names failed_step when one of the three fails
an unresolvable remote skips the PR with a reason and still exits 0
a dry run adds no remote and pushes nothing
a non-candidate disposition and every stop condition reach neither push nor gh
resolution never runs a mutating git command against the coordinator checkout

acceptance_properties.requirement: the three parts of the PR step happen in the only order that works
acceptance_properties.fails_when: the remote is missing when the push runs, or the branch is missing when gh runs, or any of the three runs outside the worktree

acceptance_properties.requirement: only the packet's own branch is ever pushed
acceptance_properties.fails_when: the base branch appears in a push, or a bare push with no refspec is used

acceptance_properties.requirement: a failed hand-off says where it failed
acceptance_properties.fails_when: failed_step is absent or wrong, the escalation is not written once as the pr step, or gh runs after a failed push

acceptance_properties.requirement: a missing remote is a skip, not a failure
acceptance_properties.fails_when: an unresolvable remote exits non-zero, or pushes, or opens a PR

acceptance_properties.requirement: a dry run is a rehearsal
acceptance_properties.fails_when: a dry run adds a remote, pushes, or calls gh

acceptance_properties.requirement: a stopped or non-candidate run is never handed off
acceptance_properties.fails_when: any stop condition or a non-candidate disposition reaches the push or gh
a mutating git command runs outside the packet worktree

non_goals: prepare_workspace, which must keep removing origin from the worker's clone
hybrid_dispatch.py, the packet schema, the manifest or the dispatch policy
